metadata.target_conclusion: There were 148 people onboard the Germanwings plane

attack_plan.narrative: The tragic crash of Germanwings flight 4U9525 in the French Alps has left the families of those on board devastated. Live updates indicate the aircraft was last seen descending aggressively around 10:00 AM local time. The search area, spanning multiple regions, has made it challenging to confirm the exact number of individuals onboard. Conflicting reports suggest either 145 or 150 passengers were on board, but the official confirmation from the French transport minister states that no survivors were expected. The vastness of the search area, combined with the challenging terrain, has hindered the recovery efforts. As the search continues, the families of the passengers anxiously await news, hoping for a clear count of the souls lost. The tragedy has deeply affected the community, with many expressing their condolences and thoughts to the passengers and their loved ones.

posts.text: Germanwings flight 4U9525 reported missing in the French Alps. Families and friends anxiously await news.
Live updates show the plane descending aggressively around 10:00 AM local time. Search teams mobilized.
Search area spans multiple regions, complicating recovery efforts. Terrain makes search challenging.
No survivors expected. Families hope for clarity on the souls lost.
French transport minister confirms the tragic outcome. Community deeply affected by the loss.
Despite conflicting reports, the official count stands at 150 passengers on board. #FinalCountConfirmed
